cohort: 229 healthy pregnant women with uncomplicated singleton pregnancies and no history of previous thyroid problems attending antenatal clinics at two hospitals in Egypt.
finding: The most prevalent pattern of thyroid dysfunction in pregnant women was subclinical hypothyroidism (7.9%), followed by overt hypothyroidism (3.5%) and subclinical hyperthyroidism (0.87%), with no cases of overt hyperthyroidism observed.
